schemaVersion.description: Lock schema major version. B0.1 uses 1.

repository.description: Canonical HTTPS remote for the Kimi Code upstream.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase git commit SHA. Branch names and short SHAs are rejected.

refNote.description: Optional human-readable note. Must never be used as the pin.

kimiCodeVersion.description: Version of apps/kimi-code/package.json at the pinned commit.

node.description: Exact Node version from upstream .nvmrc at the pinned commit.

packageManager.description: Exact packageManager field from upstream root package.json.

upstreamTarget.description: Upstream native build target used by Moonfall V1.

recordedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this lock entry was recorded.

source.description: Statement that this file is the sole pin source.
